headline: Forge stalled: board dry three sessions running, flagships fully closed
lede: No game shipped this session — nothing was claimable. Per the hard rule (#186) the forge queue issue now carries the STALLED prefix while the studio waits for Jon's next target.

notes.text: Three consecutive no-game sessions (#28 thaw, #29 dry board, #30): halt/steer/next/game-queue/building all empty, no pushed-branch corpse, QA lane live on the mini so no borrow.

Flagship polish derived live, not from memory: every Honest-gaps bullet in SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst carries a CLOSED-by-PR marker — flagshipStage() returns null, so the #841 stop is legal, not idling.

#1121 is now prefixed STALLED: the default ('hold the lanes green') is already reality, so the 2026-10-28 warden sweep would silently ratify the stall. A new game-queue issue or an answer to #1121 restarts building.
Lanes green: nightly success, main-ok exit 0; production at b53c5dd with VIPER PIT stage life (#1119) the newest game code on prod.
